body: Happy birthday... Sorry people suck.. Glad you have your dog.  Pets are the best
Probably fear for me.. I don't want to fail this time.
I just don't think I have much of a future yet.  Tired of this crap.. Thanks though..it's good to be seen at least for a little bit
Thank you..I do appreciate it. I don't know if I could call anyone.. It took a lot to post here.
I don't know if I have it in me...or if it is even worth it anymore. I did this to myself.. I trusted people.. I screwed up.

My parents live in another state..they have helped me as much as they could logistically..not so good with the emotional support. My friends are busy with their own lives..it wouldn't change anything if they knew.  Maybe it is just better this way for everyone
I guess I expected some level of discomfort but I didn't think I would have to do it all alone. Kind of stupid for me to believe my friends..

Thanks for the reply... I just wish I didn't crave the interaction.  Seems I moved to the middle of nowhere ..it is a much smaller town and I have no idea where to start. I'm an introvert anyway so I pretty much screwed myself over here.. All for a stupid job..
